Side panel for the Grandmaster — mockup

For your OK, before any code: “Panel size”, each person’s own

Everything you decided, together. The pictures are the preview (fake data) with the new parts put on the real page. Amber box = what’s new.

What it does

  • Panel size in your own account menu, under “This device”: Standard (today’s panel) · Large (names 14 px under the icons) · Largest (bigger icons too). New people start on Standard.
  • Saved with your account: it follows you to every PC and tablet you sign in on (Supabase’s own per-person settings; no migration). It opens at your size straight away, with no jump while loading. A change reaches your other devices the next time the dashboard opens there, or within about an hour.
  • PC and tablet change. Phones held upright don’t (no side panel, so no row in their menu); a phone turned sideways gets the tablet panel and the row.
  • At the main desk, the shared “Staff” login has one size for everyone at the desk.

How it behaves

  • Pointing with the mouse greys the icon’s pill, not the whole button. Testing still opens its page menu beside the panel, and Standard’s name labels still appear — drawn above the page, so nothing cuts them off.
  • Keyboard and screen readers: the row works like “This device” (Enter opens it and lands on the ticked size, which is read out; the arrows move; Enter picks; the menu stays open).
  • Short windows: the side panel and the menu scroll on their own, so the page and the top bar stay put; the section you’re on stays in view. This also fixes a phone turned sideways today, where Prospects and Finance are off-screen.
  • Saving fails: the amber bar under the top bar, on every page, with Retry and ×: “Couldn’t save your panel size, so your other devices keep the old one. Check the internet, then Retry.” It never closes by itself (rulebook §3.5).

What your OK records in the rulebook (v1.118)

  • Panel size: each person’s own choice of Standard · Large · Largest, in their account menu (the row’s icon, ti-layout-sidebar, joins §2.4’s icon map).
  • Names under the icons on PC when Large or Largest is chosen (changes §1.3 and §2.3 for that person); names 14 px (§7); 24 px panel icons on Largest (an exception to §2.2).
  • Saved with the account in Supabase’s per-person settings: display choices only, never anything about who can see or do what; the second exception, after Change password, to “writes go through the database’s own functions”; not a school record, so not in the change log.
  • The side panel and the account menu scroll on their own in short windows; the failed-save words above.

Known, and Color Belt’s to fix

  • Color Belt’s roster already overlaps text at 640 px wide today (“LT White →” runs into “Cash”: 11 overlapping pairs in the 4 rows of the preview), but not at 700 px. With Largest it also overlaps at 700 px (not at 768). This change doesn’t cause it; I’ll pass it to the Color Belt session.

Your OK lets me record it in the rulebook (v1.118) and build it, with a review, the checks and both builds, then commit (no push).
